Art-Net 4 / sACN · ESP32-P4

Open-source LED lighting, from control to fixture

pixfrog is a complete open project: the Art-Net 4 / sACN controller firmware on the ESP32-P4, the 1U rack, the electronics that condition the bus, the power satellites at the far end of a run, and LED bars coming next.

8 outputs 64 universes 9 pixel protocols 30 scenes FSEQ microSD OTA A/B MIT licensed
01

A complete rack — open, and documented.

FAILSAFE · per-channel fallback NVS · settings that persist MICROSD · xLights / FPP shows
02

The desk is on the front panel. The detail is in the browser.

The on-device display shows network, services and per-channel activity at a glance — protocol, universe, pixels, brightness and a live status LED per output.

03

Built natively on ESP-IDF, tuned for deterministic timing.

Protocols

9 pixel protocols

WS2815, WS2812B, WS2811, SK6812, WS2814, APA102, SK9822, LPD8806 — per-channel colour order, gamma, white balance, brightness and dead-pixel gaps.

Network

Art-Net 4 + sACN

ArtDmx, Sync, Trigger, TimeCode and remote config; opt-in sACN (E1.31) with priorities and 2-source HTP/LTP merge — up to 64 universes. DHCP, static, or a link-local / Art-Net 2.x fallback.

PARLIO / DMA

Parallel DMA output

The ESP32-P4 PARLIO peripheral clocks all 8 lines in parallel out of PSRAM triple buffers — 20 to 120 Hz, steady and jitter-free.

Display

On-device UI

Colour TFT bar (or classic OLED) and a rotary encoder — live FPS, link, per-line activity and full configuration, no laptop needed.

Web / OTA

Web UI & OTA

Opt-in embedded web app in English and French: configuration, live status, OTA with A/B rollback, JSON backup, coredump, optional password.

microSD

FSEQ player

xLights/FPP .fseq shows from microSD (zstd, hot-plug): play once, loop, or a playlist with repeats and autostart — free-running or slaved to ArtTimeCode and FPP MultiSync.

Scenes

Scenes & zones

30 scenes, 11 effects, 4-colour palettes, crossfades; different scenes on different outputs, at boot or as the per-line signal-loss failsafe.

Show control

DMX control universe

Any desk drives master, blackout, strobe, scenes per zone, speed, colours, fade time and show files on channels you lay out — with an OFL fixture profile.

NVS

Persistent config

Every setting lives in NVS and survives reboots and updates, with a loud warning on the home screen if flash goes bad.
